Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614459. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join activities to assays, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
